title: Factory Commissioning
summary: Bring a small EP grid online, then scale into high-voltage routing and logistics.
body: A readable Tech Wave starter has generation, storage, routing, processing, and depot movement. Build one section at a time and document every pack-specific change in Index.
steps: Use Terminal as the operator dashboard.
Build a Reinforced Solar Panel or Biofuel Generator.
Place a Field Battery Bank before the first machine row.
Route High Voltage Cable through a Factory Substation.
Scan one PowerGrid node with Lens and place HoloMap markers for the factory rooms.
Use RuntimeGuard before expanding beyond the starter line.
commonMistakes: Hiding long cable runs with no HoloMap marker.
Adding custom recipes without an Index page.
